title: Preparations for the Temple

questions.question: Which king sent servants to Solomon after hearing of his anointing?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:1 (ESV): "Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon..."

questions.question: What did Solomon intend to build?
options: A house for the name of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: A house for the name of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:5 (ESV): "And so I purpose to build a house for the name of the LORD my God..."

questions.question: What kind of wood did Solomon request from Hiram?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:6 (ESV): "Now therefore command that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me..."

questions.question: What did Solomon give Hiram in exchange for the timber?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:9 (ESV): "...and you shall meet my wishes by providing food for my household."

questions.question: What existed between Hiram and Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:12 (ESV): "...And there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty."

questions.question: How many men took part in the forced labor draft from all Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:13 (ESV): "King Solomon drafted forced labor out of all Israel, and the draft numbered 30,000 men."

questions.question: How were the 30,000 men sent to Lebanon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:14 (ESV): "And he sent them to Lebanon, 10,000 a month in shifts. They would be a month in Lebanon and two months at home..."

questions.question: Who was in charge of the forced labor?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:14 (ESV): "...Adoniram was in charge of the draft."

questions.question: How many burden-bearers did Solomon have?
How many stonecutters did Solomon have in the hill country?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:15 (ESV): "...and 80,000 stonecutters in the hill country..."

questions.question: How many chief officers were over the work?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:16 (ESV): "...besides Solomon's 3,300 chief officers who were over the work..."

questions.question: Why could David not build the house of the LORD?
options: Because of the warfare surrounding him
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the warfare surrounding him
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:3 (ESV): "You know that David my father could not build a house... because of the warfare with which his enemies surrounded him..."

questions.question: How did Hiram convey the timber to Solomon?
options: In rafts by sea to the place Solomon directed
questions.correctAnswer: In rafts by sea to the place Solomon directed
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:9 (ESV): "...I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place you direct..."

questions.question: What specific quantity of wheat did Solomon give Hiram year by year?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:11 (ESV): "Solomon gave Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household..."

questions.question: What group assisted Solomon's and Hiram's builders in preparing timber and stone?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 5:18 (ESV): "Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the men of Gebal did the cutting..."

key_verse_text: And so I purpose to build a house for the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD said to David my father, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place, shall build the house for my name.’ (ESV)
